sources.title: eval-apply/silvann_tq_D8_qwen_image_2.1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Built with Qwen. Qwen-Image 2.1 packed for the SiLVANN engine: its diffusion transformer and its text encoder (Qwen3-VL) with every matrix at 8 bits — the encoder's last four layers and every norm exact — 17.5 GB where Qwen ships 31 GB — and its VAE, processor and scheduler as Qwen ships them. The changes are in ATTRIBUTION.md.
